target_customer: E-commerce, SaaS and B2B website owners and agencies that want to personalize site content per visitor
problem: Websites show every visitor the same content, so conversion suffers. Existing personalization tools are heavy to set up, so Dynamite offers a one-line JavaScript install that picks approved content per visitor in under 300ms.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, pricing not found

founders.name: Samraaj Bath
previous_startups: ion (AI development for non-technical teams, YC launch)
founders.background_notes: YC page bio says he built an early LLM powered Figma-to-code product and an autonomous design agent, and has been through YC twice. Education and prior employers are not stated on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A client-side script that selects among approved content variants in under 300ms needs low-latency decisioning and broad site compatibility, but relies on standard web and ML techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Personalization and A/B tools were established categories and a snippet-based product is copyable. Integrations and customer data connections add some switching cost, but no customers are named.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Webflow acquired Intellimize in 2024 and Mastercard owns Dynamic Yield, so well-funded players held the same wedge. A vendor blog (unverified) says Mutiny discontinued its personalization product in April 2026.

market_need_then: Website conversion optimization and personalization were an established spend category in 2023 and 2024, and LLMs lowered the cost of generating content variants. No customer-specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses usedynamite.com, a prefixed domain, rather than an exact dynamite.com.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches found only unrelated companies called Dynamite and no press about this brand. The site footer reads 'makers of Dynamite' under ION Design.

pivots.from: ion design, AI that designs and tests landing pages and Figma-to-code
pivots.why: The company says Dynamite grew out of its ion.design work; no further reason was found.

outcome_analysis: Dynamite is an active, tiny team of three that grew out of ion.design and was in YC Winter 2024. No funding, customers or press were found beyond its own site, so the outcome so far is unclear. It competes in a crowded personalization market where Intellimize was bought by Webflow and Dynamic Yield sits inside Mastercard.
notes: Competitor list left empty: the dated competitor search returned mostly 2026 vendor blogs and nothing dated near the 2024 batch for Dynamite itself. Funding search returned only an unrelated defunct Dynamite Labs; no funding found and a cross-check found nothing. Mutiny discontinuation claim comes from vendor blogs and is unverified.
